verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a dedicated 'Transform MCP server' that lets AI tools/agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, etc.) ingest, partition, enrich, chunk, and embed local files directly through Unstructured, which is a first-party, officially supported MCP integration for connecting agents to the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working end-to-end and deeper API-level documentation beyond the overview page.
